self_consistency.forward_passes: 1 greedy + k=10 sampled (one generation batch of k samples) per query
self_consistency.note: no fit-time cost at all (fully unsupervised, no training step); pairwise agreement across the k=10 samples via the SAME self-consistency proxy HaloScope's own fit step uses (_self_consistency_membership_score), reused rather than reimplemented, to avoid two copies of the same logic diverging

selfcheckgpt.forward_passes: 1 greedy + N=20 sampled (one generation batch of N samples) + up to N NLI calls, per query
selfcheckgpt.note: no fit-time cost at all (fully unsupervised, no training step); paper's own N=20, not this file's usual k=10 for other sampling baselines
